name: thumbstack-personal-book-manager
description: A warm, secure personal book manager built with Next.js, Express, and MongoDB.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@thumbstack/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@thumbstack/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@thumbstack/api && npm run build --workspace=@thumbstack/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
